events.body:
### Summary
In `blt-api/src/handlers/organizations.py`, two endpoints lack proper access control and data minimization checks.

### Actual Behavior
- **`GET /organizations/{id}/integrations`**: Can be accessed without authentication. It returns raw integration details, including plaintext `webhook_url` values that contain embedded secret tokens.
- **`GET /organizations/{id}/managers`**: Automatically decrypts `email_encrypted` and exposes personal manager email addresses to any unauthenticated caller.

### Expected Behavior
- **`GET /organizations/{id}/integrations`**: Should require authentication, verify that the caller is an organization admin or manager (returning 401/403 otherwise), and mask webhook tokens in read responses.
- **`GET /organizations/{id}/managers`**: Should only return public profile information (username, score, avatar, join date) without decrypting or including personal emails.

### Potential Impact
- Leaked incoming webhook URLs allow unauthorized parties to post arbitrary messages to private internal channels (e.g., Slack, Discord), impersonate alerts, or abuse rate limits.
- Exposing personal manager email addresses leads to PII leakage and targeted phishing risks for organization leads.
events.title: blt-api: add access control to organization integrations and prevent manager email leakage
